en.title: EVA Air named 2027 APEX Five Star Global Airline and wins Best Wi-Fi in Greater China
en.summary: EVA Air took home two APEX honours in Singapore: the 2027 Five Star Global Airline award and Best Wi-Fi in Greater China, judged from feedback by more than a million passengers across 600-plus airlines.
body: The Airline Passenger Experience Association (APEX) held its annual awards ceremony in Singapore on November 19, where EVA Air won the highest honour, the 2027 APEX Five Star Global Airline award, together with the regional title of Best Wi-Fi in Greater China.

The APEX awards cover more than 600 airlines worldwide and are based on feedback from more than one million real passengers, independently audited by a third party across five core measures: seat comfort, cabin service, onboard catering, entertainment systems and connectivity. EVA Air said it has been investing in cabin hardware and digital services, refining seat design and comfort across its fleets and improving the quality and coverage of inflight Wi-Fi.

EVA Air also earned its 11th consecutive SKYTRAX five-star rating this year and was named the world's best international airline for 2026 by Travel + Leisure. The carrier said it will keep investing in fleet hardware and software to deliver a safer, more comfortable journey for travellers worldwide.

zh.title: 長榮航空再獲APEX全球五星級航空肯定並奪大中華區最佳機上網路
zh.summary: 長榮航空在APEX年度頒獎典禮拿下2027全球五星級航空與大中華區最佳機上網路兩項大獎；評選涵蓋逾600家航空公司，依據逾百萬名旅客的搭乘回饋。
body: 國際航空乘客體驗協會(APEX)11月19日在新加坡舉行年度頒獎典禮，長榮航空再度獲得國際肯定，除了榮獲最高榮譽2027全球五星級航空外，同時拿下大中華區最佳機上網路區域冠軍，一舉抱回兩項大獎。
APEX航空大獎評選涵蓋全球逾600家航空公司，依據逾百萬名真實旅客的搭乘回饋，並經獨立第三方專業機構嚴格審核，針對座椅舒適度、客艙服務、機上餐飲、娛樂系統及網路連線等五大核心指標進行全方位評比。長榮航空表示，近年積極投入客艙硬體與數位服務優化，持續精進各機隊座椅設計與舒適度，並提升高空無線網路的連線品質與服務覆蓋率。
長榮航空今年亦連續11年獲得SKYTRAX五星級航空公司殊榮，更榮獲Travel+Leisure頒發的2026全球最佳國際線航空公司第1名。長榮航空表示，將持續投入機隊軟硬體更新，致力為全球旅客締造更安全、舒適且充滿溫度的飛行旅程。
